description: Verify that DUT-emitted UDP datagrams carry the caller-specified Source Port (RFC 768 'Fields' SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 768 'Fields' says the Source Port is set by the application — when an upper-tester asks DUT to emit a UDP with a specific src_port, that exact value must reach the wire. This case asks DUT to emit a UDP with a known src_port and asserts the captured packet carries it.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpTriggerSendUdp request (src_port = K)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - src_port == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries src_port = K.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_src_port — DUT emitted UDP with a different src_port (UI value not propagated)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested src_port — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_src_port: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong src_port
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
